The '''Old Tion Brotherhood''' was a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] organization that operated from the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]; The [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Teff'ith]] at one point was a member, and [[Zedania]] was one of its active leaders.
